title: ameletia tenella
intro: Ameletia tenella, commonly known as the "Mexican Prickly Poppy," is a species of flowering plant in the family Apocynaceae. The plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, with reported health benefits including its antiseptic, anti-inflammatory, and antispasmodic effects. The bioactive constituents of Ameletia tenella include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which have been shown to exhibit therapeutic actions such as antioxidant, antimicrobial, and analgesic activities. Additionally, the plant has been used to treat various ailments, including digestive issues, skin irritations, and respiratory problems.
